content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe is available in 46 countries, but it's still a centralized platform, meaning you're at its mercy. PayPal has a broader reach, but a suspended account can hold your funds for up to 180 days without appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy cater to specific niches, but their services are often limited and expensive. These options come with trade-offs like fees, commissions, and data ownership issues. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that gives you full control, zero fees, and complete data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy often exclude entire countries or have strict requirements for doing business there. This leaves creators like you without access to essential services. COREMERCH, on the other hand, focuses on restricted regions like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan, providing a reliable infrastructure that's designed to work in these areas. This means you can sell digital products without worrying about platform restrictions or country-specific limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to work in restricted countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

PAA (Platform Agnostic Architecture) is the answer. By choosing COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy. This means you're not at the mercy of platform restrictions, currency collapses, or financial isolation. You have complete control over your infrastructure, data, and sales.
You can sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy with COREMERCH's PAA solution.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up your COREMERCH infrastructure, follow these steps: Choose the right Stack (Sovereign Starter or Edge Commerce) based on your needs. Set up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting. Configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic. Integrate your Supabase or Google Sheets order storage. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Activate your NOWPayments account and configure automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
